cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills, from a survey.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 61: a programme shown in more than one location counts; national evidence is not needed): the government and UNDP's Macetjeni iHub trained over 100 people in its pilot (SWZ-003, SWZ-006), and the National Cybersecurity Agency enrolled 486 citizens in online courses (SWZ-013), so stage 3.
